stackfacts/keywords: check my dependencies for known vulnerabilities
npm PyPI Go crates.io Maven advisories

description: Check dependencies or a lockfile for vulnerable and malicious packages: up to 50 purls, or a package-lock, yarn.lock, requirements.txt or poetry.lock, on OSV.

format.description: The lockfile's format; detected when left out

lockfile.description: Instead of packages: the text of a package-lock.json, yarn.lock (v1), requirements.txt or poetry.lock; its distinct exact versions are checked (at most 50). The raw lockfile may also be sent as the whole body

packages.description: Package URLs with versions, in order. Types: npm, pypi, golang, cargo, maven (nuget, gem and composer are answered as ecosystem_unavailable until imported)

items.description: purl with a version, e.g. pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.20 or pkg:maven/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core@2.14.1

name: stackfacts_osv_check
